We believe the best packaging does more than hold a product.

CONSIDERED, INSIDE & OUT

Small details.
A different feeling.

The weight of a lid. The texture of paper. The way a ribbon gives, just a little, as a box opens.

These are the details behind our approach to packaging: a clear purpose, a considered structure and an experience that feels connected to the product inside.

FORME is a space for exploring those possibilities, from classic gift boxes to a complete bespoke presentation.
